(6) Electronic configuration of diatomic on the basis of molecular orbital theory:

(7) Electronic configuration of diatomic on the basis of molecular orbital theory:

(8) Electronic configuration of diatomic on the basis of molecular orbital theory:

(9) Electronic configuration of diatomic on the basis of molecular orbital theory:



All the electrons are paired in the bonding and anti-bonding molecular orbitals; hence, is a diamagnetic molecule

Answer. The are 6 diamagnetic species among the given diatomic molecules.
